topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines the focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition and pattern recognition receptor pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system senses infection and tissue damage using molecular patterns and diverse pattern recognition receptors.

topics.label: Sentinel cell activation, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic inflammatory consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how activated tissue sentinel cells coordinate leukocyte extravasation, lymphatic drainage, and potential systemic inflammatory escalation.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammatory adaptations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover the mechanisms required to terminate inflammation, restore damaged tissue, and contain unresolved infections through chronic responses.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on the complement system.
